item: 6-1472 gh1-107 #32 — 꼬리 의문문 앞 마침표 · 소문자 wasn't → 쉼표(부가의문문 과)

text.from: Fortunately he was fast and accurate. wasn't he?
text.to: Fortunately, he was fast and accurate, wasn't he?

right: Fortunately he was fast and accurate, wasn't he?
wrong: Fortunately he was slow and accurate, wasn't he?

text.from: 그들은 다음에 함께 저녁 식사할 것이다
text.to: 그들은 다음에 함께 저녁 식사할 것이다.

item: 6-1474 gh1-106 #18 — 내무부는 그 집을 끝내 취득하지 않음(PL 107-137 은 권한만 줌) → 권한을 받았다

text.to: 내무부가 그 집을 취득할 권한을 받았죠?

text.from: The Interior Department acquired the home, didn't it?
text.to: The Interior Department was authorized to acquire the home, wasn't it?

right: The Interior Department was authorized to acquire the home, wasn't it?
wrong: The Interior Department acquired the home, didn't it?

item: 6-1474 gh1-106 #21 — 연방 사적지가 된 적 없음 → 의회가 되기를 원했다(#22 '부시가 그 법안에 서명' 과 이어짐)

text.from: 왜 레이건의 어린 시절 집이 연방 역사적 장소가 되었나?
text.to: 왜 의회는 레이건의 어린 시절 집이 연방 역사적 장소가 되기를 원했나?

text.from: Why did Reagan's childhood home become a federal historic site?
text.to: Why did Congress want Reagan's childhood home to become a federal historic site?

right: Why did Congress want Reagan's childhood home to become a federal historic site?
wrong: Why did Reagan's childhood home become a federal historic site?

item: 6-1480 gh1-108 #47 — 잡화점(여러 물건) ↔ grocery store(식료품점) → 한국어를 영어 답에 맞춤

text.from: 그는 언제 그의 고향에서 작은 잡화점을 열었나?
text.to: 그는 언제 그의 고향에서 작은 식료품점을 열었나?
